items.title: Additional Residential Unit (ARU) Zoning Regulation Update
notes: Report from B. Salmon, Managing Director of Planning & Development B. Salmon, Managing Director of Planning & Development provided an overview of the report, indicating the addition of one or more dwelling unit to existing residences is a form of gentle residential intensification that has been permitted by municipal planning regulations for several years. He outlined the changes to the final draft noting staff are of the opinion the proposed amendment is in accordance with the provisions of the Planning Act and its regulations.

items.title: OLG Funding Allocation Policy
notes: Report from A. McNabb, Managing Director of Corporate Services & Treasurer
Adam McNabb, Managing Director of Corporate Services & Treasurer provided an overview of the report and outlined the proposed amendment to the Township’s allocation policy as follows:
92% to Township Capital
4% to Community Impact Grants
2% to Heritage and
2% to Economic Development.
Councillor Wilton suggested allocating the 2% heritage transfer to the housing reserve as seed money to facilitate projects related to stainable housing.
D. Wilson, CAO responded to questions regarding future funding of housing initiatives and the establishment of a housing advisory committee.

motions.item_title: Additional Residential Unit (ARU) Zoning Regulation Update
motions.text: THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington adopt a zoning by-law amendment to regulate Additional Residential Units in Centre Wellington; AND THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington confirms that further public notice is not required; AND THAT the corresponding by-law be given three readings and passed.

motions.text: THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington receive report PLN2025-45, Annual Termite Report for information; AND THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington approves the removal of Aetna Pest Control as one of the preferred contractors installing the Sentricon product in the Township of Centre Wellington; AND THAT consideration be given to amending the OLG allocation policy and 2026 staff draft budget direction to coincide with the financial analysis detailed in Report PLN2025-45.
motions.text_html: THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington receive report PLN2025-45, Annual Termite Report for information; AND THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington approves the removal of Aetna Pest Control as one of the preferred contractors installing the Sentricon product in the Township of Centre Wellington; AND THAT consideration be given to amending the OLG allocation policy and 2026 staff draft budget direction to coincide with the financial analysis detailed in Report PLN2025-45.

motions.text: THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington directs staff to redirect the 2% heritage allocation to the housing reserve for 2026.
motions.text_html: THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington directs staff to redirect the 2% heritage allocation to the housing reserve for 2026.

motions.text: THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington authorize the Mayor and Clerk to execute a by-law to amend the OLG Funding Allocation Policy as amended; AND THAT the Council of the Township of Centre Wellington directs staff to use the Council amended policy in the 2026 Budget, with the policy to be reviewed as part of the 2027 Budget.
